## 更新内容 / Changes

### Claude Desktop 旧实例显示修复 / Legacy Claude Desktop label fix

- 修复从旧版本迁移的 Claude Desktop 实例缺少 `launchMode` 时被显示为 Claude Code CLI 的问题。实例卡片和启动预览现在会结合保存的客户端登录边界识别为 Claude Desktop，并继续保留原有配置、登录状态和会话目录。
- 保持 Claude Desktop 与 Claude Code CLI 的运行方式、连接方式和隔离边界独立；新建实例仍可在 Claude 客户端中选择桌面应用或 CLI 终端。

- Fixed legacy Claude Desktop instances whose records predate `launchMode` and were incorrectly labelled as Claude Code CLI. The instance card and launch preview now use the saved client-login boundary to identify Claude Desktop while retaining the existing configuration, sign-in state and session directory.
- Claude Desktop and Claude Code CLI keep separate launch modes, connection modes and isolation boundaries. New instances can still choose the desktop application or CLI terminal in the shared Claude wizard.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

本版本延续 v0.11.1 的 Codex 与 Claude 支持范围：Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 的独立实例和客户端内登录或 API / 第三方连接，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和 Claude 订阅 OAuth 连接。Anthropic Messages 网关可用于 Desktop API 与 CLI 连接，模型、协议和认证方式按密钥保存。云模式和 npm 包装启动器仍未接入。

This release keeps the v0.11.1 support scope: Codex desktop / CLI, independent macOS Claude Desktop instances with client sign-in or API / third-party connections, and the official native macOS Claude Code CLI with API Key, Bearer and Claude subscription OAuth connections. Anthropic Messages gateways can be used by Desktop API and CLI connections, with models, protocols and credentials stored per key. Cloud modes and npm wrapper launchers remain unintegrated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

来源为 [v0.11.2 tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.11.2)。本版本重新运行 Claude UI 回归测试、类型检查、Electron / Go 构建、公开仓库检查和发布工作流；旧 `client_login` 记录缺少 `launchMode` 的显示回归由自动化测试覆盖。GitHub Actions 的匹配运行、来源提交和 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 以本 Release 页面附件及工作流记录为准。真实付费账号的 Desktop 登录、Chat / Code / Cowork 或订阅请求未在本版本中宣称为端到端验收。

The source is the [v0.11.2 tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.11.2). This release reruns the Claude UI regression suite, type checks, Electron / Go builds, the public repository check and the release workflow; an automated test covers legacy `client_login` records without `launchMode`. Use the matching GitHub Actions run, source commit and `SHA256SUMS.txt` attached to this release as the publication evidence. Real-account Desktop sign-in, Chat / Code / Cowork and subscription requests are not claimed as end-to-end verified in this patch release.
